title: Require quality evidence before closing a project
body: Synthetic fixture for an offline maintainer pilot. All names, paths, identifiers, and changes are fictional.
author: example-contributor
diff:
diff --git a/src/lifecycle-policy.js b/src/lifecycle-policy.js
--- a/src/lifecycle-policy.js
+++ b/src/lifecycle-policy.js
@@ -8,4 +8,8 @@
-function canClose(project) { return project.workComplete; }
+function canClose(project) {
+  return project.workComplete
+    && project.qualityEvidence === 'passed'
+    && project.unresolvedItems.length === 0;
+}
diff --git a/test/lifecycle-policy.test.js b/test/lifecycle-policy.test.js
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/lifecycle-policy.test.js
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+test('blocks closure without quality evidence', () => {
+  assert.equal(canClose(incompleteEvidenceProject), false);
+});
diff --git a/docs/status-capsule.md b/docs/status-capsule.md
--- a/docs/status-capsule.md
+++ b/docs/status-capsule.md
@@ -3,2 +3,3 @@
-Status: complete
+Status: quality-check
+Closure evidence: pending
